dialogues.jp: 「……腹減ったぞぉ」
dialogues.en: "I'm so hungry."
dialogues.text: "I'm so hungry."

dialogues.jp:
午前の授業も全て終了。う〜ん、と背伸びをし
ながら、ため息をはく。
dialogues.en: The morning classes are over. I stretch, breathing a sigh.
dialogues.text: The morning classes are over. I stretch, breathing a sigh.

dialogues.jp:
そっと横を窺うと、田端が特に包帯もバンソウ
コウもはらずに平然と座っていた。
dialogues.en:
When I look at the next seat, Tabata is sitting calmly
without a bandage or a band aid.
dialogues.text:
When I look at the next seat, Tabata is sitting calmly
without a bandage or a band aid.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君、お弁当とか持ってきた？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, did you bring your lunch today?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, did you bring your lunch today?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん……いや、そんな奇跡的なことはない」
dialogues.en: "Mmm... No, a miracle like that never happens to me."
dialogues.text: "Mmm... No, a miracle like that never happens to me."

dialogues.jp:
視線を戻し、落書きをしていた教科書をしまい
つつ首を振る。
dialogues.en: I shake my head, putting away the textbook full of doodles.
dialogues.text: I shake my head, putting away the textbook full of doodles.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そうか、それは都合がいい。白河さんと食堂
　に行こうと思っていてな」
dialogues.en:
"That's good. I'm thinking to go to the dining hall with
Shirakawa-san."
dialogues.text:
"That's good. I'm thinking to go to the dining hall with
Shirakawa-san."

dialogues.jp:
ことりと話を通していたのか、くるり、と杉並
が椅子を後ろに向けた。
dialogues.en:
I guess he made an arrangement with Kotori. Suginami turns
his chair to face backward.
dialogues.text:
I guess he made an arrangement with Kotori. Suginami turns
his chair to face backward.

dialogues.jp: 「どうでもいいが、早く席替えをしたいな」
dialogues.en: "I want to change seating soon."
dialogues.text: "I want to change seating soon."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふっ……そんなに俺と隣になりたいのか」
dialogues.en: "Huh, you want to sit next to me, don't you?"
dialogues.text: "Huh, you want to sit next to me, don't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前と点対称な位置なら、教卓の前でもいい
　わ！」
dialogues.en:
"I'd rather sit right at the front of the class than sit
next to your."
dialogues.text:
"I'd rather sit right at the front of the class than sit
next to your."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「バカな！　机が隣だと教科書を忘れても、嬉
　し恥ずかしく、隣同士で見せ合えばいいのだ
　ぞ！？」
dialogues.en:
"You, idiot! If we're next to each other, we can share the
textbook sneakily in case you forget."
dialogues.text:
"You, idiot! If we're next to each other, we can share the
textbook sneakily in case you forget."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうなったら潔く寝るぞ俺は……」
dialogues.en: "In that case, I'll be a good sport and take a nap."
dialogues.text: "In that case, I'll be a good sport and take a nap."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まぁまぁ。ほら、クラスが一緒になったお祝
　いに皆でご飯を食べようと思ってね♪」
dialogues.en:
"Hey guys. Let's eat lunch together to celebrate that we are
all in the same class."
dialogues.text:
"Hey guys. Let's eat lunch together to celebrate that we are
all in the same class."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん、どうしたのふたりとも？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「いや、ちょっと突っ込みが入らなくて、間が
　おかしくなった……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I don't know how to respond to an out-of-place
comment like that."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I don't know how to respond to an out-of-place
comment like that."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「パターンを変えるべきか……」
dialogues.en: "You shouldn't say it like that."
dialogues.text: "You shouldn't say it like that."

dialogues.jp:
漫才ではないのだが、どうにも、ことりとの会
話の感覚がまだ掴みきれていない。
dialogues.en:
I'm not talking about a stand-up comedy, but somehow I can't
get used to Kotori's rhythm of conversation.
dialogues.text:
I'm not talking about a stand-up comedy, but somehow I can't
get used to Kotori's rhythm of conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉いるか〜」
dialogues.en: "Where are you, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Where are you, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お姉ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Oh, oneechan."
dialogues.text: "Oh, oneechan."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「暦先生だ」
dialogues.en: "It's Koyomi-sensei."
dialogues.text: "It's Koyomi-sensei."

dialogues.jp:
俺とさくらみたいなやり取りをしつつ、暦先生
が教室に入ってくる。
dialogues.en:
As we chat the way Sakura and me do, Koyomi-sensei comes
into our classroom.
dialogues.text:
As we chat the way Sakura and me do, Koyomi-sensei comes
into our classroom.

dialogues.jp: 「なんです？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと話があるんだが、今大丈夫か？」
dialogues.en: "I need to talk to you. Is now okay?"
dialogues.text: "I need to talk to you. Is now okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「えーと……」
dialogues.en: "Well..."
dialogues.text: "Well..."

dialogues.jp: ふたりの顔を窺う。
dialogues.en: I look at Suginami and Kotori's faces.
dialogues.text: I look at Suginami and Kotori's faces.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「別に食堂は逃げないからな」
dialogues.en: "The dining hall is always there."
dialogues.text: "The dining hall is always there."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「食事は明日でもいいよ」
dialogues.en: "We can do lunch together tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "We can do lunch together tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「――だ、そうです」
dialogues.en: "That's what they say."
dialogues.text: "That's what they say."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「自己主張しろよな……いや、じゃあ、３人と
　も生物準備室まで付き合ってくれ」
dialogues.en:
"You should speak up for yourself. Well then, do you mind
coming to the science preparatory room with me?"
dialogues.text:
"You should speak up for yourself. Well then, do you mind
coming to the science preparatory room with me?"

dialogues.jp:
なにか問題があるというよりは、面倒な雰囲気
で暦先生が手招きする。
dialogues.en:
It's not that there's a problem, it's just that the way
Koyomi-sensei beckons us is annoying.
dialogues.text:
It's not that there's a problem, it's just that the way
Koyomi-sensei beckons us is annoying.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「昼休みは貴重なんだから早く」
dialogues.en: "Hurry up, you don't wanna miss precious lunch recess."
dialogues.text: "Hurry up, you don't wanna miss precious lunch recess."

dialogues.jp:
いまいち話題に確定をつけられず、俺はのこの
こと後に従った。
dialogues.en: I just follow her, wondering what this is all about.
dialogues.text: I just follow her, wondering what this is all about.

dialogues.jp: 多分だが、さくらのことだろう。
dialogues.en: I think it's probably about Sakura.
dialogues.text: I think it's probably about Sakura.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ブラックコーヒーと、ミルク入りコーヒーが
　あるけど、なんか飲む？」
dialogues.en: "I can make coffee black or with milk. Which do you like?"
dialogues.text: "I can make coffee black or with milk. Which do you like?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いや、いいですよ別に」
dialogues.en: "I'm fine."
dialogues.text: "I'm fine."

dialogues.jp:
教員棟の中でも際立って縁のない部屋で、つい
物珍しく辺りを見渡してしまう。
dialogues.en:
This room has no vegetation comparing to the other faculty
building.
dialogues.text:
This room has no vegetation comparing to the other faculty
building.

dialogues.jp: 「私物多くないですか？」
dialogues.en: "There's a lots of personal stuff around, isn't there?"
dialogues.text: "There's a lots of personal stuff around, isn't there?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「職員室においておくには、荷物が多すぎるか
　らなぁ……ま、研究所出身の講師の中じゃ、
　これでも少ないほうだ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I have too much stuff to keep in the faculty office.
But this is nothing compared to the stuff that the other
teachers who are former researchers have."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I have too much stuff to keep in the faculty office.
But this is nothing compared to the stuff that the other
teachers who are former researchers have."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp:
別に縁のない話題なので軽く流した。と言うか、
腹減った。
dialogues.en:
I just pretend to listen because I'm not really interested,
but I'm still hungry.
dialogues.text:
I just pretend to listen because I'm not really interested,
but I'm still hungry.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あと、昼飯代わりにこれをやろう。後で食べ
　れるようにな」
dialogues.en: "I'll give you this for lunch. You can eat it later."
dialogues.text: "I'll give you this for lunch. You can eat it later."

dialogues.jp:
机の中を漁りながら、暦先生が菓子パンの袋を
並べる。
dialogues.en:
Looking inside her drawer, Koyomi-sensei puts some sweet
buns on the desk.
dialogues.text:
Looking inside her drawer, Koyomi-sensei puts some sweet
buns on the desk.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……なんか準備いいですね」
dialogues.en: "You're ready for an emergency, aren't you?"
dialogues.text: "You're ready for an emergency, aren't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「まぁな」
dialogues.en: "Why not?"
dialogues.text: "Why not?"

dialogues.jp:
暦先生がタバコに火をつけないで指で遊びなが
ら、軽く間をおく。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei plays with a cigarette between her fingers
without lighting it.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei plays with a cigarette between her fingers
without lighting it.

dialogues.jp:
３人とも座れる椅子がないので、暦先生も立っ
たまま俺達を見つめる。
dialogues.en:
There aren't enough chairs for us all to sit, so
Koyomi-sensei looks at us without sitting.
dialogues.text:
There aren't enough chairs for us all to sit, so
Koyomi-sensei looks at us without sitting.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「実は３人に面倒事を頼もうと思ってさ」
dialogues.en: "I'd like to ask you something unpleasant."
dialogues.text: "I'd like to ask you something unpleasant."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「面倒事？」
dialogues.en: "Something unpleasant?"
dialogues.text: "Something unpleasant?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なんのことお姉ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "What is it, oneechan?"
dialogues.text: "What is it, oneechan?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、蝶々だ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, a butterfly."
dialogues.text: "Oh, a butterfly."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「現実から逃げるなよ朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Don't try to escape from reality, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Don't try to escape from reality, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Oooh..."
dialogues.text: "Oooh..."

dialogues.jp: さて、と呟いて暦先生が机によりかかる。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei leans against the desk after she mutters.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei leans against the desk after she mutters.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「用件のメインはお前なんだけどな朝倉」
dialogues.en: "I want to ask you mainly, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "I want to ask you mainly, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「え、俺ですか？」
dialogues.en: "What? Me?"
dialogues.text: "What? Me?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「正確には芳乃講師とこの島に関する問題だ」
dialogues.en: "It's about Yoshino-sensei and this island."
dialogues.text: "It's about Yoshino-sensei and this island."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「さくら？　島？」
dialogues.en: "Sakura? This island?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura? This island?"

dialogues.jp: 島？
dialogues.en: This island?
dialogues.text: This island?

dialogues.jp:
さくらの件に関しては予想の範囲内だったが、
隣に並ぶことりと杉並も顔をいぶかしげにして
いた。
dialogues.en:
I would understand if it's just about Sakura. Suginami and
Kotori next to me look perplexed as well.
dialogues.text:
I would understand if it's just about Sakura. Suginami and
Kotori next to me look perplexed as well.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、島のことは考えなくてもいい。お前達
　に出せる情報は限られているんだ……企業秘
　密ってやつでね」
dialogues.en:
"Well, don't worry about the island. I can't tell you
everything, it's a kind of business secret."
dialogues.text:
"Well, don't worry about the island. I can't tell you
everything, it's a kind of business secret."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「企業秘密だって言っちゃっていいんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you telling us the business secret?"
dialogues.text: "Are you telling us the business secret?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「信用を得られなければ仕事は頼めない」
dialogues.en:
"If I didn't trust you, I wouldn't ask you to perform this
task."
dialogues.text:
"If I didn't trust you, I wouldn't ask you to perform this
task."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生がうっすらと微笑む。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei grins.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei grins.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「とりあえず、皆には例の芳乃講師が事故や事
　件の現場に現れるという件を調べて欲しいん
　だ」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, I want you to check whether it's true that
Yoshino-sensei has showed up at the site of the accidents."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, I want you to check whether it's true that
Yoshino-sensei has showed up at the site of the accidents."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待ってください」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me."

dialogues.jp: 言葉にポツポツと棘が生まれる。
dialogues.en: My voice is cold.
dialogues.text: My voice is cold.

dialogues.jp:
「学園でもさくらのこと疑ってるんですか？　
　だから俺達にさくらのことを調べろと？」
dialogues.en:
"Is the whole school suspicious of Sakura? That's why you
want us to check up on Sakura?"
dialogues.text:
"Is the whole school suspicious of Sakura? That's why you
want us to check up on Sakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「落ち着け朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Calm down, Junichi."
dialogues.text: "Calm down, Junichi."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「お姉ちゃん……いえ、暦先生、私もそんなこ
　とするのは嫌です」
dialogues.en:
"Oneechan... I mean, Koyomi-sensei, I don't want to do
this."
dialogues.text:
"Oneechan... I mean, Koyomi-sensei, I don't want to do
this."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことり」
dialogues.en: "Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "Kotori?"

dialogues.jp: にっこり、とことりが俺に微笑む。
dialogues.en: Kotori gives me a smile.
dialogues.text: Kotori gives me a smile.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私は芳乃さんとクラスメートでしたけど、彼
　女はそんなことする子じゃありませんよ」
dialogues.en:
"I was in the same class as Sakura before. She's not the
kind of person who could do such a terrible thing."
dialogues.text:
"I was in the same class as Sakura before. She's not the
kind of person who could do such a terrible thing."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「待て待て……ふたりとも落ち着け。よく考え
　ろ。逆だよ」
dialogues.en:
"Hold on... Calm down, both of you. Think about it
carefully. It's the other way around."
dialogues.text:
"Hold on... Calm down, both of you. Think about it
carefully. It's the other way around."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いいか朝倉。もし、芳乃講師の無実を証明し
　たいなら、逆にこの話には乗っておくべきだ」
dialogues.en:
"You know what, Asakura? If you want to prove she's
innocent, you'd better take this deal."
dialogues.text:
"You know what, Asakura? If you want to prove she's
innocent, you'd better take this deal."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、なるほど」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp: 杉並がポンと手を打つ。
dialogues.en: Suginami claps his hands.
dialogues.text: Suginami claps his hands.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「芳乃講師の能力と外見を理解できない一部の
　人間にとっては、彼女はただの異分子」
dialogues.en:
"If people haven't seen her true talent and appearance,
Yoshino-sensei would just seem like a weirdo to them."
dialogues.text:
"If people haven't seen her true talent and appearance,
Yoshino-sensei would just seem like a weirdo to them."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「今回の件は、彼女を排除するには最高の事件
　だが、あいにく証明の最後の部分だけが情報
　不足で手詰まりになっている」
dialogues.en:
"It's a perfect opportunity for them to get rid of her with
this incident, but they don't have enough evidence to prove
that she did it."
dialogues.text:
"It's a perfect opportunity for them to get rid of her with
this incident, but they don't have enough evidence to prove
that she did it."

dialogues.jp:
まるで授業をするように、暦先生が左右に歩を
振る。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei walks back and forth as if she was lecturing
in a class.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei walks back and forth as if she was lecturing
in a class.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「一部の不理解な人間達は、しかし芳乃講師の
　能力そのものは認めているから、万が一の可
　能性も潰しにかかったわけだが……」
dialogues.en:
"Some people against her admit what a talented teacher she
is, so they are getting ready for the worst case."
dialogues.text:
"Some people against her admit what a talented teacher she
is, so they are getting ready for the worst case."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「分かるか朝倉？　圧倒的なこの場面で、学園
　はお前達に調査の権限を与えると言っている
　んだ」
dialogues.en:
"Do you understand, Asakura? The school officials will give
you a green light to investigate this."
dialogues.text:
"Do you understand, Asakura? The school officials will give
you a green light to investigate this."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……」
dialogues.en: "Really..."
dialogues.text: "Really..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ひっくり返せるかも知れないんだ」
dialogues.en: "We may be able to turn things around."
dialogues.text: "We may be able to turn things around."

dialogues.jp: 無言で暦先生も頷く。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei nods silently.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei nods silently.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「聞き込みも講師は見てみぬ振りをするし、講
　師権限での学園のデータベース閲覧も許可が
　下りる」
dialogues.en:
"The teachers would look away when you do interviews with
people, and plus, you can go through the database of the
school without asking permission."
dialogues.text:
"The teachers would look away when you do interviews with
people, and plus, you can go through the database of the
school without asking permission."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「期限は４月いっぱい――それまでに芳乃講師
　の無実を証明してみせろ」
dialogues.en:
"The deadline is the end of April. By then, you've got to
prove Yoshino-sensei is innocent."
dialogues.text:
"The deadline is the end of April. By then, you've got to
prove Yoshino-sensei is innocent."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「それで、｛・・／大人｝が彼女の無実を発表してくれる
　んですね」
dialogues.en:
"After that, you as an adult will give an announcement to
the school, right?"
dialogues.text:
"After that, you as an adult will give an announcement to
the school, right?"

dialogues.jp: 学園内での神がさくらを弁護してくれるわけだ。
dialogues.en: I guess the god of school will stand up for Sakura.
dialogues.text: I guess the god of school will stand up for Sakura.

dialogues.jp: 先生は頷き、ようやくタバコに火をつけた。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei nods and lights a cigarette.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei nods and lights a cigarette.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「承諾でいいかな？」
dialogues.en: "So, you guys will do it, right?"
dialogues.text: "So, you guys will do it, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「俺は……でも」
dialogues.en: "Well..."
dialogues.text: "Well..."

dialogues.jp: ことりと杉並に目を向ける。
dialogues.en: I look at Kotori and Suginami.
dialogues.text: I look at Kotori and Suginami.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「手伝うよ朝倉君♪」
dialogues.en: "I'll help you, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "I'll help you, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「かったりぃな〜」
dialogues.en: "It's a pain in the neck, though."
dialogues.text: "It's a pain in the neck, though."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……誰の真似だお前？」
dialogues.en: "Who are you imitating?"
dialogues.text: "Who are you imitating?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ははは！　こうやってお前はいつも面倒なこ
　とばかりしているのだ。毎日の食堂Ａランチ
　で手を打とう！」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha! This is how you always make trouble. Let's close a
bargain while we eat at the dining hall."
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha! This is how you always make trouble. Let's close a
bargain while we eat at the dining hall."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Aahh..."
dialogues.text: "Aahh..."

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく面倒なので、呟かずにため息だけ漏
らす。
dialogues.en:
I just give a sigh instead of mumbling because I'm too
tired.
dialogues.text:
I just give a sigh instead of mumbling because I'm too
tired.

dialogues.jp: あぁ、なんて、かったるい仕事だ。
dialogues.en: Oh, man! What a pain in the neck this job is!
dialogues.text: Oh, man! What a pain in the neck this job is!

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、解散……ふぅ」
dialogues.en: "Okay, you're dismissed... Whew."
dialogues.text: "Okay, you're dismissed... Whew."

dialogues.jp:
杉並になにかのプリントの束を渡して、暦先生
が呟きながら嬉しそうに呟いた。
dialogues.en:
Handing some kind of batch of papers to Suginami,
Koyomi-sensei lights a cigarette with a satisfied look.
dialogues.text:
Handing some kind of batch of papers to Suginami,
Koyomi-sensei lights a cigarette with a satisfied look.

dialogues.jp: 「あの、暦先生」
dialogues.en: "Um... Koyomi-sensei."
dialogues.text: "Um... Koyomi-sensei."

dialogues.jp: ことりと杉並が廊下に出たのを見て振り返る。
dialogues.en:
I turn around after making sure that Kotori and Suginami are
out in the hallway.
dialogues.text:
I turn around after making sure that Kotori and Suginami are
out in the hallway.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「先生はどうして、さくらの味方を？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you taking Sakura's side?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you taking Sakura's side?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あん、お前なに言ってるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, what are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, what are you talking about?"

dialogues.jp:
出来の悪い学生を見るよう――いや、｛ひゆ／比喩｝になっ
てない。
dialogues.en:
She looks at me like I'm a poor student, and no, that's not
figurative.
dialogues.text:
She looks at me like I'm a poor student, and no, that's not
figurative.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あのな、芳乃講師でも、お前でも同じことを
　言うと思うぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"You know what? I know Yoshino-sensei will say the same
thing you do."
dialogues.text:
"You know what? I know Yoshino-sensei will say the same
thing you do."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 暦先生がタバコを振る。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei shakes her cigarette.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei shakes her cigarette.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「問い、先生とは一体誰の味方でしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Question. Which side do the teachers usually take?"
dialogues.text: "Question. Which side do the teachers usually take?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「俺達……学生」
dialogues.en: "Us... Students."
dialogues.text: "Us... Students."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「証明終わり」
dialogues.en: "That's the answer."
dialogues.text: "That's the answer."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……面倒ですね」
dialogues.en: "It's complicated, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "It's complicated, isn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「仕事だよ」
dialogues.en: "It's a job."
dialogues.text: "It's a job."

dialogues.jp: ぽあ、と輪っかの煙が宙に吐き出される。
dialogues.en: A ring of smoke is breathed forth into the air.
dialogues.text: A ring of smoke is breathed forth into the air.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「後はさ……」
dialogues.en: "The rest of it..."
dialogues.text: "The rest of it..."

dialogues.jp: ぼそり、と。
dialogues.en: Bluntly...
dialogues.text: Bluntly...

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いや、さっきの芳乃講師の話を聞いていたん
　だが、ちょっとハズレているけど悪い子じゃ
　ないよ」
dialogues.en:
"I was listening when Sakura-sensei was talking, and I think
she's not a bad kid, even if she is a little bit off."
dialogues.text:
"I was listening when Sakura-sensei was talking, and I think
she's not a bad kid, even if she is a little bit off."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あたしも人の心だけは、科学や物理で解明さ
　れないことを祈る人間の一人だ……というか、
　恋愛の成功が確率で出るのなんて嫌だろ？」
dialogues.en:
"She said she's one of those people who thinks the human
mind shouldn't be explained by science or physics. And she
also said it's strange to use probability to determine
whether a love affair goes well or not."
dialogues.text:
"She said she's one of those people who thinks the human
mind shouldn't be explained by science or physics. And she
also said it's strange to use probability to determine
whether a love affair goes well or not."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「人は機械を作るが、その人の心は機械ではな
　い。非論理的なことと無駄の生産が人の正常
　なのさ。これぞ科学のパラドクス」
dialogues.en:
"Humans can make a machine, but the human mind is not a
machine. The normal state of a human being is illogical and
wasteful. This is the real paradox of science."
dialogues.text:
"Humans can make a machine, but the human mind is not a
machine. The normal state of a human being is illogical and
wasteful. This is the real paradox of science."

dialogues.jp: そこで、クツクツと小さく笑いが漏れる。
dialogues.en: There is a little chuckle.
dialogues.text: There is a little chuckle.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「それに、あのチョーク投げは面白かった」
dialogues.en: "And also, I liked how she threw the chalk."
dialogues.text: "And also, I liked how she threw the chalk."

dialogues.jp: ◆暦先生からの依頼◆
dialogues.en: ◆A request from Koyomi-sensei◆
dialogues.text: ◆A request from Koyomi-sensei◆

dialogues.jp:
昼休み、ことりと杉並と一緒に、暦先生に呼ば
れる。
dialogues.en:
During the lunch recess, Koyomi-sensei called me in with
Kotori and Suginami.
dialogues.text:
During the lunch recess, Koyomi-sensei called me in with
Kotori and Suginami.

dialogues.jp:
なんでも、例の女子学生の事件をネタに、さく
らを講師から辞めさせようという話が持ち上がっ
ているらしい。
dialogues.en:
According to her, there is a rumor that some people are
trying to kick Sakura out of the school, using the story of
that girl who was in the accident.
dialogues.text:
According to her, there is a rumor that some people are
trying to kick Sakura out of the school, using the story of
that girl who was in the accident.

dialogues.jp:
それを解決して欲しいと。俺達はなんとかさく
ら先生を守るために、一肌脱ぐことにした。
dialogues.en:
She asked us to solve the problem. We decided to do her a
favor to keep Sakura-sensei.
dialogues.text:
She asked us to solve the problem. We decided to do her a
favor to keep Sakura-sensei.
